items.title: Sam Darnold: Still tracking toward Week 12 start
items.text:
Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Darnold (quadriceps/rib) made a "good bit of progress" over the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and will start Sunday at San Francisco if he fares well during practice this week, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports. "I think it's probably wise to wait to make any declarations [on Darnold's status] until we get through Wednesday's practice," Macdonald added.

items.title: Jacory Croskey-Merritt: Scores TD in return from injury
